title: Two women we remember with love
intro: Today we remember two women, from Lazio and Sicily. We share only what trusted sources have told us, and we hold them in our thoughts with gratitude.

women.name: Rosella Aquilani
tribute: Rosella Aquilani was 62 years old and lived in Viterbo, in the Ellera district. She was originally from Vetralla and was a foster grandmother to two children. She is in our thoughts.

women.name: A woman from Siculiana
tribute: She was 56 years old and lived in Siculiana. She is in our thoughts.
